name: Joe Damato
biography: is a systems programmer who spends his days hacking on the Ruby VM and tools for analyzing the performance characteristics of complex software systems. He maintains a blog (http://timetobleed.com) where he releases code, patches to the Ruby VM, and his thoughts on low level systems programming. He maintains memprof, a Ruby level memory profiler and added support for libdl to trace.
